findings.passage: Election security: Indiana is a national leader in election security for holding the line on voter ID laws, citizenship verification, and ensuring the security of absentee ballots. I will work to build on this strong foundation and work proactively to give our voters confidence in our elections.
findings.note: From his 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey answer on his three key campaign messages. He says Indiana's voter ID laws, citizenship verification and absentee ballot security are a strong base and says he will build on them.

findings.passage: As Secretary of State, Max will fight to protect election integrity, reduce government red tape, and uphold Indiana’s conservative values.
findings.note: Biography text in his 2026 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, written in the third person for his campaign. He names election integrity as a priority.

findings.passage: Transparency portal: a direct channel for citizens to report potential election issues themselves.
findings.note: In the same 2026 survey he proposes a portal where citizens report possible election problems directly to the Secretary of State.
